subject: Renewal playbook: timing & evaluation milestones
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.inference>
To: Clara Norton <clara.norton@brightline.co>, BrightLine Procurement <procurement@brightline.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 3 Nov 2027 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Renewal playbook: timing & evaluation milestones

Clara / team —

Following our renewal kickoff last week, attaching an updated playbook (BRIGHTLINE_MAP_v3.pdf) and a starter evaluation plan (BrightLine_evaluation_plan.xlsx). High-level proposal below — this is the weekly checkpoint summary so we can keep the timelines tight for your Q4 procurement window.

Snapshot:
- Current usage: 450k tokens/day across Content & Support teams; pilot expansion targeting +60% by Jan.
- Priority add-ons: fine-tuning extension, dedicated capacity pool (reserved GPUs), and advanced logging retention.
- Procurement milestone target: contract signed by 2027-12-20 to hit Jan reserved capacity start.

Proposed evaluation timeline (compact option):
1) Week of 11/08 — Technical deep-dive & integration test (2 devs, 2 hours) — owner: Marissa
2) Week of 11/15 — Controlled load test + latency/accuracy baselines — owner: Aditya
3) 11/22–11/26 — Security & compliance handoff (SOC2 evidence + network review) — owner: Laura
4) 12/01 — Final procurement review + SOW & pricing confirmation — owner: Markus/Laura

Action items for this week (owners):
- Marissa: book technical deep-dive with BrightLine infra team (link to calendar in Drive).
- Aditya: prepare cost delta for dedicated pool vs. hosted burst (spreadsheet tab: cost-scenarios).
- Laura: assemble SOC2 artifact list and draft procurement clause for retention.
- Clara/Samir: confirm decision window and any internal timing constraints (procurement approval dates).

Attachments: BRIGHTLINE_MAP_v3.pdf (MAP with milestones), BrightLine_evaluation_plan.xlsx (test matrix + success criteria).

If you want to compress the evaluation into a single-week sprint we can, but it will require additional engineering hours (we've flagged that in the spreadsheet). Proposed sync: Tue 11/09 16:00 ET — 30 min alignment.

Thanks —
Markus Klein
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.inference | +1 415-555-0124

Attachment: BRIGHTLINE_MAP_v3.pdf (11 pages)
Attachment: BrightLine_evaluation_plan.xlsx (test matrix)
From: Clara Norton <clara.norton@brightline.co>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.inference>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@brightline.co>, BrightLine Procurement <procurement@brightline.co>
Date: Wed, 3 Nov 2027 13:40:12 +0000
Subject: Re: Renewal playbook: timing & evaluation milestones

Thanks Markus — this is helpful. A few quick notes:

- Appreciate the compact timeline. Procurement is targeting sign by 12/15, so your dates align nicely.
- Can we shorten the load/accuracy baseline to a 3-day window? We can commit two engineers for that period.
- Procurement will require the SOC2 report + data retention terms by 11/22 — can Laura confirm that list?
- Also, Samir asked whether you can provide an estimated monthly cost for a dedicated pool of 2x A100-equivalent GPUs vs. the hosted burst model; he flagged potential budget constraints.

We can do Tue 11/09 at 4pm ET. Please confirm calendar invite.

Date: Thu, 4 Nov 2027 10:05:30 +0000
Subject: Re: Renewal playbook: timing & evaluation milestones

Clara — thanks for the quick reply. Confirming the adjusted approach below and next steps after our 11/09 sync.

Revised evaluation (compressed):
- 11/08 (Tue): Technical deep-dive + integration checks (Marissa to run checklist; we will provide sample load generator).
- 11/15 (Tue) – 11/17 (Thu): 3-day load + accuracy baseline — Aditya will run tests and populate the evaluation sheet.
- 11/22: Security artifacts (Laura to deliver SOC2 package & evidence list).
- 12/01–12/06: Contract walkthrough and SOW draft — Laura/Markus.

Cost note: Aditya will produce the 2x A100-equivalent dedicated pool estimate by EOD 11/05. Early estimate in the sheet (tab: cost-scenarios) shows ~1.9x the hosted burst monthly for predictable throughput; final will include committed discounts.

Links: evaluation plan (Drive): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1xEvalPlan
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/4472

Action list (owners & deadlines):
- Marissa: create meeting invite for 11/09 16:00 ET; include infra contact + test run notes (owner: Marissa) — due: 11/05
- Aditya: finalize cost scenarios + dedicated pool quote — due: 11/05
- Laura: SOC2 artifact list + suggested contract language for retention — due: 11/22
- Markus: coordinate procurement touchpoint and SOW draft — due: 12/01

Attachment: BrightLine_evaluation_plan.xlsx (updated with compressed timeline).

Date: Fri, 5 Nov 2027 15:47:00 +0000
Subject: Fwd: Renewal playbook: timing & evaluation milestones

Internal note — looping you both for approvals and prep.

Marissa / Laura — good meeting on Tue will be important to land the compressed evaluation. Heads-up: procurement may push for a one-time onboarding credit or tiered discount once we show the 3-day evaluation results. If that comes up, we should be prepared with two options: (A) onboarding credit of $25k + 6% committed discount on Dedicated pool; (B) waived onboarding + 3% larger committed discount.

Please do the following before Tue 11/09:
- Marissa: publish the integration checklist in the Drive folder and include the infra contact list (due EOD 11/05).
- Laura: draft the procurement clause for data retention and a short note on approval process for discounts (I may need you to pre-clear the revenue impact) — due EOD 11/05.
- Aditya: confirm we can produce the dedicated 2x A100-equivalent quote with both list and committed pricing (I cc'd you so you see the ask).

Keep replies internal here — I will surface final negotiation points to Clara after we have approvals.

Thanks —
Markus
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
